label: At GO after an unrewarded a1-to-S2 trial, strongest early in episode and when belief favors S1.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S2 u') ;; (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S2 u') * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S2 u') * (tv('reward', -2) == 0)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == 2) * belief_lo
explanation: Active only at GO. Magnitude is essentially an indicator of the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded (residual +0.69, all other patterns about -0.08), declining across the episode (weight -0.21 per episode decile on top of the timing decline) and somewhat larger when the ideal observer believes S1 is good (belief_lo). Other previous-trial patterns, D1 and D2 contribute nothing. Free fit adding a2 S2 u and a generic unrewarded-S2 x belief term gains only ~0.01 on dev. Remaining misses are mostly window-first trials whose previous trial is unseen in the window. No future variables used.

issues: The belief claim is not supported. Removing the belief_lo term drops test R^2 beyond timing only from 0.6333 to 0.6298. Without ep_dec in the model, the belief_lo term adds 0.0001 (0.3815 -> 0.3816). The (belief_lo > 0) variant scores 0.6297. The positive belief deciles in the profile come from the a1 S2 u pattern itself, not from belief. So 'when belief favors S1' in the label is effectively false.

The core claims hold. Activation is zero at D1 and D2. At GO the residual after a1 S2 u is +0.69, while every other pattern sits near -0.08 (a2 S2 u is +0.02). last_is alone scores 0.38 on test, and adding the ep_dec interaction raises it to 0.63 (weights +1.69 and -0.21 per decile). That means the feature has faded to roughly zero by deciles 8-9, so the episode-time dependence is large, not a minor modifier.

Misses on the short form show one systematic error class: the GO step of the window's first trial, where the previous trial is unknown. Several worst-fit windows have activation of about 2.0 there against a prediction of 0.19. Adding (phase == GO)*(prev_action == -1)*(prev_reward == 0) raises test R^2 to 0.648, but this is a window artifact rather than an interpretation.

There is also a small real modifier: within a1 S2 u the feature is weaker when the trial before that was also unrewarded (weight -0.31). Replacing the belief term with this one gives test R^2 0.643, against 0.633 for the recorded short form.
